crossRefs.note: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill…
When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant…
Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
translations.bsb: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.
translations.kjv: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
translations.asv: And Moses rose up, and Joshua his minister: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
